about: The Andean Festival of the Sun around the June solstice, when Indigenous communities near Otavalo and Cotacachi dance from house to house for days.

about: Latacunga’s festival blends Indigenous, African and Catholic traditions around the figure of the Mama Negra, with colourful parades in September and November.

Das Fest in Latacunga verbindet indigene, afrikanische und katholische Traditionen um die Figur der Mama Negra, mit bunten Umzügen im September und November.

A festa de Latacunga mistura tradições indígenas, africanas e católicas em torno da Mama Negra, com desfiles em setembro e novembro.
